title: EXTRACTION PAYS THE BONUS AND THE GEAR, NOT YOUR SCORE
why: His ruling of 11-01: an extraction should pay no cash beyond selling what you have and maybe a bonus, and most the money should come from selling gear. v37.25 ended the other raid cash, but every career extraction still banked twice the raid score as money on top of the bonus (job 265). The score now stays score, and the money card loses its credits rows.
now: an extraction banks its bonus, no longer your raid score as cash; money comes from selling gear
